#Getting regional data
```{r}
#regional lists
Midwest <- c('IL', 'WI', 'IN', 'MI', 'OH', 'MN', 'MO', 'IA', 'ND', 'SD', 'NE', 'KS')
Northeast <- c('ME', 'VT', 'NH', 'MA', 'CT', 'RI', 'NY', 'PA', 'NJ')
South <- c('WV', 'MD', 'DE', 'KY', 'VA', 'TN', 'NC', 'OK', 'AR', 'TX', 'LA', 'MS', 'AL', 'SC', 'GA', 'FL')
West <- c('WA', 'OR', 'ID', 'MT', 'WY', 'CA', 'NV', 'UT', 'CO', 'AZ', 'NM', 'AK', 'HI')
US_State <- c(Midwest, Northeast, South, West)

#trace metals
Midwest_trace <- subset(trace_elements, State %in% Midwest)
Northeast_trace <- subset(trace_elements, State %in% Northeast)
South_trace <- subset(trace_elements, State %in% South)
West_trace <- subset(trace_elements, State %in% West)

#energy type
Midwest_NRG <- subset(energy_type, location %in% Midwest)
Northeast_NRG <- subset(energy_type, location %in% Northeast)
South_NRG <- subset(energy_type, location %in% South)
West_NRG <- subset(energy_type, location %in% West)
```
#Metal aggregate datasets
```{r}
State <- trace_elements$State[!duplicated(trace_elements$State)]
mean_metal <- data.frame(State)
#metal.cols[1]$trace_elements
#print(aggregate(unlist(trace_elements['V_P01106_Aluminum_wf']) ~ State, trace_elements, mean))
for(i in metal.cols){
  #agg <- aggregate(trace_elements[i], list(State=trace_elements$State), mean)
  agg <- aggregate(as.numeric(unlist(trace_elements[i])) ~ State, trace_elements, mean, na.rm=TRUE, na.action=NULL)
  mean_metal <- merge(mean_metal, agg, by.x='State', by.y='State')
  names(mean_metal)[length(mean_metal)] <- i
}

Date <- trace_elements$Sample_date[!duplicated(trace_elements$Sample_date)]
mean_metal_time <- data.frame(Date)
for(i in metal.cols){
  agg <- aggregate(trace_elements[i], list(Date=trace_elements$Sample_date), mean, na.rm=TRUE)
  mean_metal_time <- merge(mean_metal_time, agg, by.x='Date', by.y='Date')
}
```
#Aggregating energy statistics
```{r}
#mean energy by state and energy type
mean_energy <- aggregate(consumption.for.eg.btu ~ location + fuelTypeDescription, energy_type, mean)
mean_energy <- mean_energy %>% pivot_wider(id_cols='location', names_from='fuelTypeDescription', values_from='consumption.for.eg.btu')
names(mean_energy) <- gsub(' ', '.', colnames(mean_energy))
mean_energy_time <- aggregate(consumption.for.eg.btu ~ period + fuelTypeDescription, energy_type, mean)

State <- energy_type$location[!duplicated(energy_type$location)]
mean_fuel_type <- data.frame(State)
for(i in fuel.type){
  subs <- subset(energy_type)
}

#aggregate metal and energy
energy_metal_state <- merge(mean_energy, mean_metal, by.x='location', by.y='State')
```

}
coal_summ <- coal_summ[-c(1,2), ]

#Strontium time series data
```{r}
Midwest_strontium <- aggregate(V_P01080_Strontium_wf ~ Sample_date, Midwest_trace, mean)
Midwest_renewable <- subset(Midwest_NRG, Midwest_NRG$fuelTypeDescription=='renewable')
Midwest_coal <- subset(Midwest_NRG, Midwest_NRG$fuelTypeDescription=='all coal products')
Midwest_renewable <- aggregate(consumption.for.eg.btu ~ period, Midwest_renewable, mean)
Midwest_coal <- aggregate(consumption.for.eg.btu ~ period, Midwest_coal, mean)
ggplot(Midwest_strontium, aes(Sample_date, V_P01080_Strontium_wf)) + geom_line()
ggplot(Midwest_renewable, aes(period, consumption.for.eg.btu)) + geom_line()+ylab('Renewable btu')
ggplot(Midwest_coal, aes(period, consumption.for.eg.btu)) + geom_line()+ylab('Coal btu')

Midwest_renewable_ts <- ts(Midwest_renewable$consumption.for.eg.btu, start=c(Midwest_renewable$period[1]), frequency=6)
dec_add <- decompose(Midwest_renewable_ts, type='additive')
plot(dec_add)
Midwest_coal_ts <- ts(Midwest_coal$consumption.for.eg.btu, start=c(Midwest_coal$period[1]), frequency=6)
dec_add <- decompose(Midwest_coal_ts, type='additive')
plot(dec_add)
```
